title: The Emperor's New Clothes in Benchmarking? A Rigorous Examination of Mitigation Strategies for LLM Benchmark Data Contamination
authors_zh: Yifan Sun, Han Wang, Dongbai Li, Gang Wang, Huan Zhang
paper_type_zh: 基准污染缓解策略评测
best_for_zh: 需要选择或设计污染缓解方案的基准维护者。
one_line: Official code release evaluates contamination-mitigation strategies under controlled settings.
以保真度和污染抵抗力审计基准更新策略。
why: It adds an auditable reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Benchmark contamination can inflate scores when test items enter model training, but replacing an established benchmark is costly and updating its questions may silently change the capability being measured. Aggregate accuracy drop or accuracy matching cannot show whether the same questions remain equally diagnostic.

This paper evaluates existing benchmark-update strategies with a controlled clean-versus-contaminated model setup. It introduces question-level fidelity and contamination resistance to ask whether an update both preserves the original evaluation and removes the benefit of memorizing the original items.

基准测试题进入训练语料会让模型靠记忆取得虚高分数；但从头建设新基准代价高昂，而改写既有题目又可能悄然改变难度、知识范围或所测能力。只比较总体准确率下降或是否相近，无法判断每道更新题是否仍在测量原来的能力。

论文用受控的干净模型与污染模型评估既有基准更新策略，并提出题目级保真度与污染抵抗力。前者检查更新后是否保留原题的判别结果，后者检查模型见过原题后是否仍能从更新题获益；两者共同回答改写能否既保真又去污染。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper turns contamination mitigation from an accuracy-level claim into a per-question matching problem. For a clean model, an updated benchmark should reproduce the original correct/incorrect vector (fidelity); after fine-tuning the model on the original benchmark, that vector on the update should stay unchanged (resistance). The contribution is an audit protocol and two metrics, not a new universal dataset. Official code provides mitigation, contamination, evaluation, and metric scripts; it does not claim a separately packaged general-purpose dataset release.
论文把污染缓解从总体准确率主张改写为逐题匹配问题：对干净模型，更新基准应复现原基准每题的对错向量，即保真度；把原基准微调进模型后，更新题上的对错向量应不变，即污染抵抗力。核心产物是审计流程与两项指标，而非通用新数据集。官方代码提供改写、污染、评测和指标计算脚本，但未将其声明为独立通用数据集发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select a clean model-benchmark pair. Retain only pairs passing three contamination detectors; this is the control for the original benchmark D.
  1. Update D separately with each strategy. The study tests 20 strategies, using GPT-4o for the automated updates; each output is an updated benchmark D^S.
  1. Create contaminated counterparts. Fine-tune the clean model on D under mild and intensive recipes, then apply three checks to verify that contamination occurred while general capability is retained.
  1. Collect three per-question evaluation vectors: clean model on D, clean model on D^S, and contaminated model on D^S. A vector entry is 1 or 0 for the item-level outcome.
  1. Score the update. Fidelity and resistance are one minus normalized Hamming distance for the first and second relevant vector pairs; high values for both accept an update as desirable. Code, model revisions, dataset versions, prompts, sampling budget, and random seeds must be fixed; unavailable details are unknown.

1. 选择干净模型—基准对。仅保留同时通过三种污染检测器的组合，作为原基准 D 的对照。
  1. 分别更新 D。对 20 种策略逐一改写，自动改写使用 GPT-4o，得到更新基准 D^S。
  1. 构造污染模型。以 D 微调干净模型，采用轻度与重度两种配方，并以三项检查确认污染发生且通用能力未明显丢失。
  1. 取得三组逐题对错向量：干净模型在 D、干净模型在 D^S、污染模型在 D^S 的结果；每题记为 1 或 0。
  1. 计算指标。两组相关向量的归一化 Hamming 距离取一减值，分别为保真度与抵抗力；两者都高才值得采用。复现须固定代码、模型版本、数据版本、提示词、采样预算和随机种子；未披露项为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim — existing update strategies do not reliably achieve both preservation and contamination resistance.

Controlled setup — across 10 LLMs, five benchmarks, 20 strategies, and mild/intensive contamination, each strategy is compared with the unmodified benchmark using the same question-level metrics. The main contrast is the update rule, while the study explicitly constructs and checks contamination.

Result — small edits usually retain fidelity above 0.9 but do not significantly beat vanilla resistance across all benchmarks. More aggressive MPA reaches only 0.686 fidelity on MMLU; semantic-altering extensions reach about 0.97 resistance but lose roughly 0.15 fidelity on average. No method reaches the desired high-high region (Table 3–4, Figure 4).

Boundary — this supports a trade-off under the selected models, benchmarks, contamination recipes, and automated updates; it does not establish that all future mitigations fail.

主张——既有改写策略不能稳定地同时保留原测量含义并抵抗污染。

受控设置——在 10 个 LLM、5 个基准、20 种策略及轻度、重度两类污染下，以未改写基准为对照并按逐题指标比较。主要变量是改写规则；污染由作者主动构造并检查。

结果——小幅改写通常保真度高于 0.9，却未在所有基准上显著超过原基准的抵抗力；更激进的 MPA 在 MMLU 的保真度仅为 0.686。改变语义的扩展法抵抗力约 0.97，却平均损失约 0.15 保真度。表 3、表 4 与图 4 中没有策略落在两项都高的理想区域。

边界——结果支持所选模型、基准、污染配方和自动改写条件下的权衡，不能证明未来所有缓解方法都会失败。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier mitigation work commonly judged success by aggregate accuracy drop or matching, which can conceal changed questions and offsetting item errors. This paper changes the decision object to paired item-level outcome vectors under both clean and deliberately contaminated models. Its actual novelty is the joint fidelity-resistance contract and controlled contamination pipeline, not the individual text perturbations. It also makes explicit why leaving a benchmark untouched has perfect fidelity but can still have poor resistance.
既有工作常以总体准确率下降或匹配判断改写成功，但这会掩盖题目含义变化及正负误差相抵。本文把决策对象改为干净模型和主动污染模型下的逐题对错向量配对。真正新意是保真度—抵抗力的联合契约及受控污染流程，而不是某一种文本扰动；它还明确了不改题虽保真度为满分，却可能没有污染抵抗力。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The protocol assumes the selected clean pairs are genuinely uncontaminated after three detectors. A missed pre-existing leak contaminates the reference vectors and weakens both scores; reuse should report the detector outputs and add provenance checks.

The study simulates contamination by fine-tuning on the original benchmark. Real training mixtures and leakage paths can differ, so the reported trade-off may not transfer unchanged; test target models and a representative contamination scenario.

Low fidelity identifies a behavioral shift but does not itself prove a factual error. The authors' examples show altered scope or difficulty, so high-impact updates still require item-level human inspection before deployment.

该流程假设三种检测器筛出的模型—基准对确实未污染。若已有泄漏未被发现，参照对错向量就被污染，两项分数都会失真；复用时应报告检测结果并补做来源审计。

作者通过在原基准上微调来模拟污染，真实训练混合和泄漏路径可能不同，文中的权衡不能原样外推；应在目标模型与有代表性的污染情境中重测。

低保真度只表明行为改变，并不能单独证明事实错误。作者示例显示题目范围或难度会变，因此高影响改写在部署前仍需逐题人工检查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
A benchmark maintainer with an existing high-quality test set can compare candidate rewrites: keep aligned original/updated items, a clean model, a controlled contaminated counterpart, and item-level outputs; run the two matching metrics and output a fidelity-resistance report plus an inspection queue. Success is high values on both metrics, not a matching aggregate score.

A model evaluator can use the code as an audit scaffold to document contamination assumptions and update effects. Do not use it as a certification for a benchmark when no credible clean control or item correspondence exists; first build those controls or use provenance and human review instead.

已有高质量测试集的维护者可比较候选改写：保留原题—更新题对齐关系、干净模型、受控污染副本及逐题输出，计算两项匹配指标，产出保真度—抵抗力报告和人工复核队列。成功标准是两项同时高，而非总体准确率相近。

模型评测者也可复用代码作为审计脚手架，记录污染假设与改写影响。若没有可信的干净对照或题目对应关系，不能把该流程当作基准认证；应先建立这些对照，或改用来源审计与人工复核。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: it audits whether updated benchmarks preserve item-level capability measurement while preventing gains from original-item exposure.
  2. Method handle: clean/original, clean/updated, and contaminated/updated vectors are the key objects; normalized Hamming matching determines both metrics.
  3. Artifact handle: the official repository supplies scripts for 20 mitigation strategies, contamination, evaluation, and metric computation, rather than a separately released universal dataset.
  4. Evidence anchor: 10 models, five benchmarks, and two contamination recipes show no strategy with both strong fidelity and resistance; MPA has 0.686 fidelity on MMLU.
  5. Reuse decision: use it to rank candidate benchmark updates; before reuse, verify a clean control and manually inspect low-fidelity item pairs.

1. 定位：审计更新基准是否仍逐题测量原能力，并阻断见过原题带来的获益。
  2. 方法抓手：干净—原题、干净—更新题、污染—更新题三组向量是核心；两项指标都由归一化 Hamming 匹配决定。
  3. 数据与工具：官方仓库提供 20 种改写、污染、评测和指标脚本，并未单独发布通用数据集。
  4. 证据锚点：10 个模型、5 个基准、两类污染下没有策略兼得高保真与高抵抗；MPA 在 MMLU 的保真度为 0.686。
  5. 复用决定：适合筛选候选基准改写；使用前须验证干净对照并人工检查低保真题对。
